verdict.rationale: Pipedream provides a documented CLI (pd deploy, pd dev, pd help) for developing and deploying custom components/event sources from local code, a REST API and TypeScript/Python/Java SDKs for building on Connect, and explicit support for contributing custom components via GitHub PRs, all corroborated by first-party docs and GitHub repo description plus community confirmation of hands-on use for custom integrations. missing for 10: deeper independent/hands-on validation specifically of the CLI/SDK developer workflow (community evidence mostly covers the low-code workflow builder rather than the CLI/SDK path).
